serverInfo.name: metricduck
serverInfo.description: SEC filing data and signals for AI agents — structured financials, filing signal screening across filings/earnings/transcripts/IR events, sector-normalized peer comparisons, stock screening, daily end-of-day stock prices, and raw XBRL facts for 5,500+ US public companies. Fundamentals from SEC EDGAR (updated daily); end-of-day prices from a market-data feed.
